# Abū Yūsuf al-Kindī

*801 – 873 · Arab · [Falsafa](../movements/falsafa.md)*

The first philosopher writing in Arabic, nicknamed "the philosopher of the Arabs": he opened [falsafa](../movements/falsafa.md) by adapting Aristotle and the Neoplatonists to Islamic thought.
